answers.answer: 250語以内です。要旨に文献引用を入れることはできません。
answers.basis: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required. The abstract must not include references.
A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.

answers.answer: 50文字以内です。3ページ目（奇数ページ）から必要です。
answers.basis: At the header on each odd page from page 3, a Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required

answers.answer: 文献番号は、[ ]で囲み、句点やコンマの直前に置きます。
answers.basis: When cited in the text, reference numbers must be put in brackets in the form [1,3,5-8] before a ‘period’ or a ‘comma’.

answers.answer: 最初の6名の著者名に続き、「et al.」を使用します。
answers.basis: For more than six authors, list the first six authors followed by “et al.”:

answers.answer: 図はTIFF、PNG、JPEG、またはPDF形式で、解像度は300 dpiが必要です。グラフィカルアブストラクトの場合は、PNG、JPEG、またはGIF形式で、解像度は300 dpiが必要です。解像度の要求は同じですが、ファイル形式に違いがあります。
answers.basis: Figures must be at a resolution high enough for printing. Electronic files of photographs and illustrations should be at 300 dpi resolution in gray scale or color at the size being printed. We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats. ... The format of the graphical abstract should be PNG, JPEG or GIF, and the resolution should be 300 dpi.

answers.answer: 以下の3点です：本文中で引用する必要があります。アラビア数字で連続して番号を振り、表の本文の上に短い説明的なタイトルを付ける必要があります。縦線を使用してはいけません。
answers.basis: All tables must be cited in the text. Number the tables consecutively with Arabic numerals (for example “Table 3”), in the order of their appearance in the text. Supply a short explanatory title above the body of the table... Do not use vertical lines.

answers.answer: 20 MBが上限です。超える場合は、J-STAGE Dataなどの関連するデータリポジトリにアップロードし、編集事務局に連絡する必要があります。
answers.basis: The size of each file that is uploaded using the online submission system such as text, tables, figures and supplementary material (if any), should be no more than 20 MB. When the supplementary materials are larger than 20 MB, please upload them to another relating BPPB data repository, J-STAGE Data (https://jstagedata.jst.go.jp/). In this case, please contact the Editorial office.

answers.answer: 「New」「Novel」「First」「Unprecedented」など、同様の記述的な単語やその形容詞は、タイトルや要旨に使用してはいけません。
answers.basis: Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”, or other similar descriptive words, and their adjectives.
Authors who have been requested to revise their manuscript should send the revised version to the handling editor within 90 days of receiving the editorial decision.
